messages:
maya: Quick heads-up 1: propose regrouping left nav: move 'Models' beside 'Deployments', tuck 'Monitoring' under Observability. Goal: reduce cross-cluster jumps. Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/console-nav
kevin: Sounds reasonable. Question: permalink stability. Docs and infra link to /models/:id today.
olivia: UX note: keep breadcrumb semantics even if nav grouping changes. Users expect Project > Models > Model > Version. Breadcrumb should reflect resource hierarchy, not nav placement.
samir: Routing preference: use path-based canonical routes (no hashes). Example routes:

```
/p/:projectId/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId
/p/:projectId/deployments/:deploymentId
```

UI-only state via query params, e.g. ?side=collapsed&panel=metrics
jordan: Accessibility: when deep-linking to a model version, ensure focus lands on the main heading, not the side nav. Add aria-current="page" to active nav items and a visible skip link to main.
a11y-bot: Mini-check: 1) aria-current on active item 2) skip-to-main present and visible 3) focus after navigation 4) descriptive link text 5) keyboard nav passes
kevin: Redirect plan: support legacy /models/:id for 12 months with 301 to new canonical path. We should add mapping middleware to translate old slugs to canonical ids.
ryan: Ops heads-up: if we change URL shapes we'll need dashboard links updated in customer-facing emails and support tickets. Suggest an automated script to scan templates.
maya: Proposed decision draft:
1) adopt path-based canonical routes (Samir)
2) UI-only state via query params, no hash routing
3) 12-month 301 redirects from legacy shapes
4) breadcrumbs always show logical hierarchy
olivia: Small UX idea: show a transient banner when landing from an external deep link: "Viewing Model X via direct link" with a CTA "Open navigation" to help users orient.
samir: Implementation detail: router should support route aliases and rollout flags. Add routeAliases table so we can fallback during canary.
kevin: I'll own middleware + redirect logic. I'll post a migration timeline and estimated rollout windows.
jordan: I'll own the accessibility checklist, write a small test plan, and add a11y checks to the PR template.
maya: I'll update the Figma, write banner copy, and draft a short RFC with route examples. Expect the RFC by EOD. :thumbsup:
kevin: One more: add telemetry event when users land from a deep link so Product can measure how many bookmarks/links are used.
ryan: We'll add a lint job to flag hardcoded links in repo and surface them in the migration PR.
maya: Thanks all. Follow-ups: kevin will share middleware branch, jordan will add a11y tests, olivia will prototype the banner microcopy. We'll sync next Tuesday if needed.
